# Workflow Inspector Core

> A free browser-based tool for static analysis of exported n8n workflow JSON.

Workflow Inspector Core analyzes n8n workflow JSON locally using ten static checks. It does not execute or modify workflows, and workflow contents are not uploaded to a server. No n8n account or server is required. JavaScript is required to use the analyzer.

The ten checks cover:
- Duplicate node identifiers and names.
- Dangling node references and malformed connections.
- Isolated nodes and disconnected node groups.
- Cycles in main connections and duplicate connections.
- Missing node identifiers and blank node names.

Available interface capabilities:
- Paste workflow JSON or select a local JSON file up to 5 MiB.
- Review findings with severity and confidence information.
- Filter, search, and group findings by rule.
- Export a JSON audit report.

Findings are structural observations and do not necessarily indicate runtime errors.

## Resources

- [Workflow Inspector Core](https://roglz.github.io/workflow-inspector/): Public browser-based analyzer.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/roglz/workflow-inspector): Source code and project documentation.
